purpose: Teach: 喜劇/白鳥/酒造/クジラ/雑学/落とし穴/飲み屋/平方メートル

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんと喜劇映画を観に行きましょうね
lines.en: Sho, let's go see a comedy film with Dad, shall we?
lines.style: Warm, maternal invitation. Soft opening. Gentle lilt on the suggestion — she's offering, not insisting. Almost conspiratorial, drawing him in.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、白鳥の湖のバレエ観たいよ
lines.en: Mom, I want to see Swan Lake ballet instead.
lines.style: Bright, sudden energy. Direct request without apology. The confidence of a child who knows his mom will listen. Quick, unburdened delivery.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんが酒造の見学に連れて行って下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, Grandpa took you on that sake brewery tour, didn't he?
lines.style: Observant, gently reflective tone. She's making a connection, not correcting. Slight lift at the end — acknowledging something he's learned. Warm nostalgia underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、絵本でクジラのお話読んだよ
lines.en: Mom, I read a whale story in a picture book.
lines.style: Quiet pride in the small discovery. Not demanding attention, but offering it. Careful articulation — he's showing her something he thinks matters. Steady pace.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんは雑学が豊富な方ね
lines.en: Sho, your dad certainly knows a lot of interesting things.
lines.style: Gentle observation, almost to herself. A moment of recognition — she's noticing patterns in what her son cares about. Warm, slightly amused. No judgment.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、テストの落とし穴に気をつけて取り組んだよ
lines.en: Mom, I was careful about the tricky parts on the test.
lines.style: Straightforward pride. Not boasting — reporting a success that matters to him. Slight emphasis on 'careful.' Voice steady and present, like he's sharing a real accomplishment.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがお取引先と飲み屋で懇談されたわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad had a business meeting with a client at a bar.
lines.style: Conversational, matter-of-fact. She's sharing an observation about his father's day. Neutral, informative tone — she's not editorializing, just narrating.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お家の広さ平方メートルで計算したよ
lines.en: Mom, I figured out the square meters of our house.
lines.style: Quiet satisfaction. He's done something precise and concrete. Matter-of-fact delivery, but there's a small brightness underneath — the pleasure of solving something. Gentle close.
